vetSays.line: 🛡️ Duc, Miras, Tiana and Grace met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Duc, Miras, Tiana, Grace are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Duc, Miras, Grace, Greta and Mara met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Miras, Grace, Greta, Mara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Greta just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mara just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Greta, Mara, Olivia, Valeria and Theo met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Greta, Mara, Olivia, Valeria, Theo are hurt.
🛡️ Grace, Mara, Olivia and Valeria met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Mara, Olivia, Valeria are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Greta just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Valeria just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

regDeaths.name: the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still
something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
